quality: All three final-source regression and native checks pass; merged patches pass the same regressions and an independent six-case simulation/export/replay/native-reader check.
primary_comparison: Equal or higher verified completion, lower median end-to-end elapsed time, and lower median total model API-equivalent cost. Report all pairs and worst-case pricing uncertainty; no failed or expensive arm is discarded.
timing: From coordinator process launch through worker shutdown and combined-patch verification. Includes repair attempts, model calls, simulation, conversion and independent verification.
cost: All measured Astra delegation, work and recovery calls; all ToFa classifier, worker, rejected and fallback responses. Missing usage stays unknown. Cached subsets are not double counted. Setup response uncertainty is retained separately.
excluded: CPU hosting, storage and network charges
